title: Re-Testing LLM-Based C-to-Rust Translations Against Their Original C
abstract: arXiv:2611.23839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most C-to-Rust translators use large language models (LLMs), and each reports a success rate from its own correctness check. We survey 34 C-to-Rust translators that use LLMs. Only one reports testing its check, and eleven release the original C and their Rust in runnable form. We re-test all eleven. We run the C and the Rust on generated inputs, compare every output, and count a divergence only where the C has no undefined behavior. All eleven release defective translations: we find 160 defects, 93 of them outright errors on ordinary inputs. Their own checks accepted 86 defective translations. For 81 of them, the released check never compared the programs on an input that exposes the defect. For three of the other five, it ran one but compared only part of the output. translated_title: 针对原始C代码重新测试基于LLM的C到Rust翻译
translated_abstract: 大多数C到Rust翻译器使用大型语言模型（LLM），并且每个都基于自身的正确性检查来报告成功率。我们调查了34个使用LLM的C到Rust翻译器，其中只有一个报告过对其检查机制的测试，且仅有十一个以可运行形式发布了原始C代码及其Rust翻译。我们对这十一个全部进行了重新测试：在生成的输入上运行C程序和Rust程序，比较每一个输出，并且只在C程序不存在未定义行为的情形下才计为分歧。结果显示，所有十一个翻译器发布的产品都存在缺陷：我们共发现160个缺陷，其中93个是在普通输入上的彻底错误。它们各自的检查接受了其中86个有缺陷的翻译。对于这86个中的81个，其发布的检查从未在能暴露缺陷的输入上运行并比较过两个程序；对于另外五个中的三个，检查虽然运行了程序但只比较了部分输出。成功率的可靠程度完全取决于其检查的质量。在将一次翻译计为成功之前，作者应当在修复循环从未见过的输入上，将每一个输出与原始C程序的输出进行比较。
tldr: 该论文重新测试了11个已发布的基于LLM的C到Rust翻译器，发现所有翻译均存在缺陷（共160个缺陷，其中93个为普通输入上的错误），证明其自报成功率不可靠，因为这些检查大多从未在能暴露缺陷的输入上完整比较输出。
en_tdlr: This paper re-tests 11 released LLM-based C-to-Rust translations against their original C programs, uncovering 160 defects (93 outright errors on ordinary inputs) in all of them, showing that reported success rates are unreliable because their own checks rarely compared full outputs on defect-exposing inputs.
